headline: Committee passes open space amendment, discusses hearing notice Bill 85-2026

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.voteItem: Amendment to the open space amendment: include the evacuation route in the open space
meeting.summary: Members took up a chair proposal to use M1 light industrial uses minus some uses, and voted six to one to count an evacuation route as open space. On Bill 85-2026, one caller asked that hearing notices also go on county bulletin boards.
meeting.recap: The chair proposed using the M1 light industrial zoning uses, minus some uses.[[0:47:12]] Bed-and-breakfasts would also be barred, except for housing people in a disaster.[[0:47:52]] This amendment passed with seven ayes and two members excused.[[1:00:56]] Members discussed a condition requiring water-saving practices, enforced by the Department of Water Supply.[[1:01:19]] Members discussed banning chain businesses, called formula businesses.[[1:05:35]] A council member moved to keep at least 20 percent of the property as open space.[[1:13:38]] The applicant said the 20 percent rule is a burden on the project.[[1:35:12]] Members voted six to one to count the evacuation route as open space.[[1:52:36]] The open space amendment passed with seven ayes.[[1:54:10]] Bill 85-2026 would let hearing notices run in a suitable publication instead of a twice-weekly newspaper.[[1:55:14]] One caller asked that notices also be posted on county bulletin boards.[[1:58:52]]
decided: In a roll call vote, the committee agreed to count the evacuation route as part of the required open space.

trackerIssues.title: Pāʻia Sugar Mill light industrial rezoning

issues.oneLine: Under the proposed M1 zoning, the owners could build apartments but not single-family homes.
issues.why: A member said that after the fire, people were moved around a lot, so B&B space could serve as temporary housing in a disaster.
issues.brief: Bed-and-breakfasts would not be allowed, except for temporary humanitarian housing in a disaster.[[#1]] Live-work units, with a shop below and a home above, would be allowed.[[#2]] Homes must be in the same building as a business or other non-home use.[[#3]]
